**Synopsis:**
Trump announced the U.S. will use oil from a newly struck deal with Venezuela to refill the Strategic Petroleum Reserve (SPR), currently near a 44-year low at ~290 million barrels. The deal requires substantial investment and infrastructure before meaningful production increases, making any near-term impact on supply or fuel prices uncertain. The SPR drawdown reflects cumulative policy decisions under both Biden and Trump administrations in response to global supply shocks.
